source: The foundation's game rules (docs/specs/00_foundation/05_defines_and_rules.md section 2) and the rows the Aenor, Afrit, Cold Lands, Dark Lands and start-situation specs supply to the same file. Read by tools/content/modules/rules.mjs. Option keys and order follow the spec; the texts never name Afrit or Eindil (the rules screen is seen before any campaign). zin_rule_gathering_dark and zin_rule_elections are not written: nothing reads zin_gathering_dark_rate or an election switch yet (their owners are the world tension and politics modules).

rules.name: The Course of the Age
rules.desc: How closely the realms that no player leads keep to the road the chronicle remembers. A player's realm always chooses for itself.

options.name: As the Chronicle Tells
options.desc: Each realm makes the choice the chronicle remembers, in its season.

options.name: As It Might Have Been
options.desc: The realms lean toward the remembered choices, but a court may still take another road.

options.name: As Each Court Wills
options.desc: Every realm weighs its own interests and chooses for itself.

rules.name: The Pace of the Age
rules.desc: How quickly the great events of the age arrive. Every remembered date moves with this rule.

options.name: Steady
options.desc: The great events come in their remembered seasons.

options.name: Slow
options.desc: The great events come later: every remembered date lies half as far again from the start.

options.name: Swift
options.desc: The great events come sooner: every remembered date lies a quarter nearer the start.

rules.name: The Man from the Ice
rules.desc: When the man asleep in the northern ice wakes. He never wakes at the start of a campaign.

options.name: Wakes as the Chronicle Says
options.desc: He wakes in Ironfrost of 4A 1749.

options.name: Wakes Early
options.desc: He wakes in Highsun of 4A 1748.

options.name: Wakes Late
options.desc: He wakes only in Ironfrost of 4A 1751.

rules.name: The Powers of the Dark
rules.desc: How boldly the dead of the south and the Mistake of the north move when no player leads them.

options.name: As the Chronicle Tells
options.desc: They keep their remembered seasons.

options.name: Bold
options.desc: They move a year early, with stronger hosts.

options.name: Restrained
options.desc: They never strike first, and fight only when attacked.

rules.name: The Middle Kingdom's Succession
rules.desc: Which camp the Middle Kingdom follows after the Golden King, when no player leads it.

options.name: Follow the Course of the Age
options.desc: The court chooses as the Course of the Age rule leads.

options.name: The Golden Court
options.desc: The court of offices keeps the throne.

options.name: The Free Dominions
options.desc: The chartered dominions take the crown's place.

options.name: Chance
options.desc: The camp is drawn once, when the campaign begins.

rules.name: The Eastern Kings
rules.desc: How the courts of the east answer a claimant to the crown of the east, when no player leads them.

options.name: Follow the Course of the Age
options.desc: Each court chooses as the Course of the Age rule leads.

options.name: Refuse the Deliverer
options.desc: No eastern court kneels, and the courts stand together.

options.name: Unite without the Deliverer
options.desc: The strongest eastern power unites the east under its own crown.

options.name: Chance
options.desc: The east's course is drawn once, when the campaign begins.

rules.name: The Elven Refusal
rules.desc: Whether the elves keep their old refusal to march in the wars of men, when no player leads them.

options.name: Follow the Course of the Age
options.desc: The elves stay apart and send only wanderers, as the Course of the Age rule leads.

options.name: The Kindred March
options.desc: When the dark grows great and an elven realm is at war with it, the elves set the refusal aside and march.

options.name: Chance
options.desc: Each elven realm decides once, when the campaign begins.

rules.name: The Black Iron Crown
rules.desc: Whether the orc kingdom of Goldoroth stays its own master or swears to the south, when no player leads it.

options.name: Follow the Course of the Age
options.desc: Goldoroth chooses as the Course of the Age rule leads.

options.name: Bows to No One
options.desc: Goldoroth keeps its own crown.

options.name: Sworn to the South
options.desc: Goldoroth takes the southern bargain and swears to Volgan.

options.name: Chance
options.desc: Goldoroth's course is drawn once, when the campaign begins.

rules.name: The Golden King's Years
rules.desc: How long the Golden King reigns over the Middle Kingdom.

options.name: As Events Decide
options.desc: His years rise and fall with the health of his court.

options.name: As the Chronicle Tells
options.desc: His reign ends in its remembered season, whatever the court does.

options.name: A Long Reign
options.desc: His reign lasts some years longer.

options.name: Players Only
options.desc: Among the realms no player leads, none acts to end his reign early.

rules.name: The Deliverer's Path
rules.desc: How the court of the Worshipdom acts when no player leads it.

options.name: Follow the Course of the Age
options.desc: The court chooses as the Course of the Age rule leads.

options.name: As the Chronicle Tells
options.desc: The Worshipdom keeps its remembered course.

options.name: As Its Court Wills
options.desc: The Worshipdom weighs every choice by its own interest.

options.name: Ambitious
options.desc: The Worshipdom reaches as far as it can.

options.name: Patient
options.desc: The Worshipdom never reaches beyond its own temples.

rules.name: Isengard and the Accord
rules.desc: How Coldor answers Isengard's defiance of the Northern Accord, when no player leads it.

options.name: Follow the Course of the Age
options.desc: Coldor chooses as the Course of the Age rule leads.

options.name: The Iron Hand
options.desc: Coldor raises the March Forts against Isengard, and no full war follows.

options.name: The Open Hand
options.desc: Coldor courts Isengard back into the Accord.

options.name: Conquest
options.desc: Coldor brings Isengard to heel by war.

options.name: As Coldor Wills
options.desc: Coldor weighs its course by Isengard's defiance.

rules.name: Start Checks
rules.desc: Checks the opening world when a campaign begins and writes what it finds to the game log. For testing.

options.name: Off
options.desc: No start checks run.

options.name: On
options.desc: The start checks run and write to the game log.
